inputs.acceptance_criteria: Exact physical DUT orderable identity and pinout supported by reviewed evidence.
inputs.description: Request traceable physical marking/orderable-suffix and package evidence; match package-specific manufacturer pinout and orientation. Produce an identity-to-pinout review record; no identity is resolved in this run.

actions.rationale: Request traceable physical marking/orderable-suffix and package evidence; match package-specific manufacturer pinout and orientation. Produce an identity-to-pinout review record; no identity is resolved in this run.

inputs.acceptance_criteria: All host/translator/DUT voltage and timing interfaces supported across intended operating conditions.
inputs.description: Request exact-device recommended and absolute-maximum I/O limits, input thresholds, output levels, unpowered behavior and SPI timing. Build a worst-case interface compatibility matrix; do not treat 133 MHz product-page frequency as adapter operating capability.

actions.rationale: Request exact-device recommended and absolute-maximum I/O limits, input thresholds, output levels, unpowered behavior and SPI timing. Build a worst-case interface compatibility matrix; do not treat 133 MHz product-page frequency as adapter operating capability.

inputs.acceptance_criteria: Reviewed implementation supports three forward paths and one simultaneous reverse path with safe disabled states.
inputs.description: Produce a per-signal translator channel/pin/port/control table for SCLK, CS#, MOSI_IO0 and MISO_IO1. Verify control grouping, OE/DIR states, startup/shutdown and partial-power behavior using implementation-specific evidence; compare candidates before selection.

actions.rationale: Produce a per-signal translator channel/pin/port/control table for SCLK, CS#, MOSI_IO0 and MISO_IO1. Verify control grouping, OE/DIR states, startup/shutdown and partial-power behavior using implementation-specific evidence; compare candidates before selection.

inputs.acceptance_criteria: Reviewed supply design meets verified DUT limits under intended conditions.
inputs.description: Select and document a proposed local 1.8 V supply with input source, current budget, regulation tolerance, transient behavior, decoupling, enable/default-off and backfeed controls. Values and component identity remain unselected.

actions.rationale: Select and document a proposed local 1.8 V supply with input source, current budget, regulation tolerance, transient behavior, decoupling, enable/default-off and backfeed controls. Values and component identity remain unselected.

inputs.acceptance_criteria: Evidence-linked review and deterministic checks have no unresolved implementation blockers; separate physical authorization still required.
inputs.description: After preceding evidence gates, draft schematic/BOM/package mapping and review unused DUT control-pin biasing, grounding, connector orientation, contention, power sequencing and timing. Run deterministic electrical and revision checks on the actual implementation.

actions.rationale: After preceding evidence gates, draft schematic/BOM/package mapping and review unused DUT control-pin biasing, grounding, connector orientation, contention, power sequencing and timing. Run deterministic electrical and revision checks on the actual implementation.

inputs.acceptance_criteria: Reviewable protocol with no fabricated measurements and no execution authority granted.
inputs.description: Prepare a future separately authorized validation protocol with unpowered continuity/orientation checks, isolated supply checks, verified-limit-based stop criteria, controlled enable sequencing and non-destructive identification/read checks before any separately authorized erase/program operation. Record results against the actual adapter revision only when performed.

actions.rationale: Prepare a future separately authorized validation protocol with unpowered continuity/orientation checks, isolated supply checks, verified-limit-based stop criteria, controlled enable sequencing and non-destructive identification/read checks before any separately authorized erase/program operation.
